_comment: delayline_offsets.C on pf-qaq run 56 (2026-10-06, X730_ThGEM_Test) (module 0): centres each delay-line XY image (mid of 1/99 % edges) by splitting its raw centre over the two arms of each axis; triggers and other channels 0.
raw centres: plane1 (-17.504, -29.801) ns from 14660 events; plane2 (-2.500, -15.152) ns from 15751 events.

Why: moving the ThGEM setup to pf-qaq at the site changed the cables (TODO 70): XL arrived ~17.5 ns after XR and Y-bottom ~30 ns after Y-up on ThGEM1, so the root_sink XY image sat off-centre; side3 had all four arms at ~88-90 ns after the trigger.

Regenerate after any cabling change: root -l -b -q 'tools/root_sink/delayline_offsets.C("<delila2root dir>/runNNNN_*.root","1,2,3,5,4","6,7,8,9,10","config/time_settings_thgem.json","<label>")'. root_sink re-reads this file at every run start: write a temp file and mv it into place.
aligned_ts = raw_ts - offset_ns (positive = channel arrives late).
